com.vector.cfg.model.sysdesc.api.taskmapping

Interface IPositionInTaskEntry


  • @PublishedApi(value=ADDITIONS_ALLOWED)
 @PublishedApiDomain(value=AUTOMATION_IF)
public interface IPositionInTaskEntry
    An IPositionInTaskEntry represents a position in task for the task mapping. The entry is able to combine several events that are mapped to one position (e.g. needed when mapping a main function of a service component and its corresponding schedulable entity).

    • Method Detail

      • areTaskMappingsMapped

        @PublishedMethod
boolean areTaskMappingsMapped()
        Checks for all getAssociatedTaskMappings() whether they are mapped.
        Returns:
        True if all associated task mappings are mapped to a task.

      • getAssociatedTaskMappings

        @PublishedMethod
java.util.Collection<? extends ITaskMapping> getAssociatedTaskMappings()
        Getter method for the task mappings at the represented position.
        Returns:
        Returns the task mappings that are mapped to the position represented by this IPositionInTaskEntry. The collection always contains at least one associated task mapping.

      • getMappedTask

        @PublishedMethod
com.vector.cfg.model.mdf.model.autosar.ecucdescription.MIContainer getMappedTask()
        Returns the task to which the getAssociatedTaskMappings() are mapped or null if they are not mapped yet.
        Returns:
        @Nullable The task container or null if the getAssociatedTaskMappings() are not mapped.

      • getOwner

        @PublishedMethod
java.lang.String getOwner()
        Retrieves the owner of the triggered executable entity. The owner is the component prototype or the module configuration or both in case of a combined mapping.

        Examples:
        If the owner is a component prototype with the name 'App1' the owner string will be 'Component App1'.
        If the owner is the module with the name 'Dem' the owner string will be 'Module Dem'
        If the owner is the module with the name 'Adc' and there is a service component named 'Service 1' with a runnable which should be mapped to the same position, the owner string will be 'Module Adc / Service Component Service1'.

        Returns:
        Returns the owner or null if not set.

      • getPosition

        @PublishedMethod
int getPosition()
        Getter method for position in task which this IPositionInTaskEntry is representing.
        Returns:
        Returns the position. -1 when no position is assigned.

      • getTriggeredExecutableEntity

        @PublishedMethod
java.lang.String getTriggeredExecutableEntity()
        Retrieves the ExecutableEntity that is represented by this position in task. In case of multiple mappings of different executable entities to one position, the string contains all mapped executable entities separated by comma.
        Returns:
        Returns the triggeredFunction (list) or null if not set.

        Setter method for position.
        Parameters:
        position - The position to set.
